name: Dreamland
detailed_description:
Dreamland

Welcome to Dreamland - a mysterious and fascinating world of dreams, where reality intertwines with fantasy, and fear and admiration go hand in hand. In this game, you will go on a fascinating journey through a world inhabited by mythical creatures and creepy characters.

Plot

We see the world through the eyes of Alexey, an ordinary worker at the logistics company "Watcher's Cargo." He has long stopped communicating with his old acquaintances. However, after several unusual incidents, Alexey begins to see symbols. Gathering together, the group decides to uncover the root cause of the events that have occurred to them.

The young people travel through several dimensions, solving puzzles and interpersonal conflicts along the way. But will they be able to overcome themselves and untangle this story? Everything depends entirely on the player and their choices.

This story is just a brief excursion into a vast and mysterious world of dreams. Will it turn into a nightmare?

Characters

In Dreamland you will meet many colorful characters, each with their own story and personality. Each of these characters adds uniqueness and depth to the atmosphere of the game. To some, they may seem very familiar. Isn't it?

Style

Dreamland combines elements of a visual novel and an interactive book, creating a familiar, yet unusual style. Bright colors and bizarre shapes intertwine with dark shadows and ominous silhouettes, creating a contrast that immerses the player in a dream world. The music, filled with mysterious melodies and sounds of nature, enhances the atmosphere and helps you forget about reality.

Immerse yourself in the world of Dreamland, where every action you take matters, and every decision can change the course of events. Are you ready to face your fears and uncover the secrets of this eerie and beautiful kingdom?

short_description: A group of young people decides to find out why they are seeing mysterious symbols. As they unravel the mystery, they travel through other worlds that are indistinguishable from those seen in dreams. One can only hope that this will not turn into a nightmare for them...

Minimum:

  • Processor: 2.0 Ghz 64-bit Intel-compatible
  • Memory: 2 GB RAM
  • Graphics: OpenGL 3.0
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 3 GB available space
  • Sound Card: N/A
  • VR Support: N/A
